assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: In bug-parsing.md, the '### Environment / Version' section (line 37) contains the vague text: 'Not sure which version -- using whatever is deployed on staging.' (line 39). The full section content is extracted and displayed.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section 4.5.2 (lines 9-24) explicitly scans for version patterns (explicit version numbers, product-prefixed versions, version keywords) and finds none. It states: 'The section contains only vague text ("Not sure which version", "whatever is deployed on staging") with no extractable version identifier.' and concludes 'Result: No version pattern could be extracted. Skipping to sub-step 4.5.6 (gap flagging).'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, section 4.5.6 (lines 39-100) outputs the gap comment. The ADF JSON payload at line 62 contains the exact text: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description \u2014 please set manually.' (with em dash). The plain-text version at line 46 renders the em dash as '--' but the actual ADF comment content matches the assertion exactly.

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, the ADF JSON (lines 64-93) includes a 'rule' separator (line 66) followed by a paragraph containing the footnote: 'This comment was AI-generated by sdlc-workflow/triage-bug v0.13.10.' where 'sdlc-workflow/triage-bug' is a hyperlink to 'https://github.com/RHEcosystemAppEng/sdlc-plugins'. This matches the Comment Footnote pattern.
